title: More Mobs Drop Things
description: Adds drops for more passive mobs, including goats, sniffers, and ocelots.
body:
## Passive Mob Drops
Adds additional drops to passive mobs that have no drops in vanilla minecraft. With said passive mobs being listed below with the drops listed within each section.


<details>
<summary>Allay</summary>
1-3 Amethyst Shard, Fire Aspect ❌, Looting ✅
</details>

<details>
<summary>Armadillo</summary>
1-3 Armadillo Scutes, Fire Aspect ❌, Looting ✅
</details>

<details>
<summary>Axolotl</summary>
0-2 Tropical Fish, Fire Aspect ❌, Looting ❌
</details>

<details>
<summary>Bat</summary>
0-1 Glow Berries, Fire Aspect ❌, Looting ❌
</details>

<details>
<summary>Bee</summary>
0-1 Honeycomb, Fire Aspect ❌, Looting ❌
</details>

<details>
<summary>Camel</summary>
0-2 Leather, Fire Aspect ❌, Looting ✅
</details>

<details>
<summary>Creaking</summary>
1-4 Resin Clump, Fire Aspect ❌, Looting ✅
</details>

<details>
<summary>Ender Dragon</summary>
0-1 Dragon Head, 6-18 Dragon Breath, Fire Aspect ❌, Looting ✅
</details>

<details>
<summary>Endermite</summary>
0-1 Chorus Fruit, Fire Aspect ❌, Looting ❌,
</details>

<details>
<summary>Fox</summary>
1-2 Sweet Berries, Fire Aspect ❌, Looting ✅
</details>

<details>
<summary>Frog</summary>
1-2 Slime Ball, Fire Aspect ❌, Looting ✅
</details>

<details>
<summary>Giant</summary>
4-16 Rotten Flesh, 0-1 Iron Ingot || Carrot || Potato, Fire Aspect ✅, Looting ✅
</details>

<details>
<summary>Goat</summary>
1 White Wool, 1-2 Mutton, Fire Aspect ✅, Looting ✅
</details>

<details>
<summary>Happy Ghast</summary>
0-1 Ghast Tear, 0-2 Gunpowder, Fire Aspect ❌, Looting ✅
</details>

<details>
<summary>Illusioner</summary>
0-1 Emeralds, 1 Ominous Bottle (If Raider), Fire Aspect ❌, Looting ✅
</details>

<details>
<summary>Mannequin</summary>
1 Player Head, Fire Aspect ❌, Looting ❌
</details>

<details>
<summary>Ocelet</summary>
0-2 String, Fire Aspect ❌, Looting ❌
</details>

<details>
<summary>Piglin</summary>

</details>

<details>
<summary>Piglin Brute</summary>
0-2 Gold Nugget, 7% Gold Ingot, Fire Aspect ❌, Looting ✅
</details>

<details>
<summary>Player</summary>
1 Player Head (Of Slain Player), Fire Aspect ❌, Looting ❌
</details>


<details>

0-1 Cobblestone, Fire Aspect ❌, Looting ❌
</details>

<details>
<summary>Sniffer</summary>
1-3 Moss Blocks, Fire Aspect ❌, Looting ✅
</details>

<details>

</details>

<details>

0-1 Amethyst Shard, Fire Aspect ❌, Looting ❌
</details>

<details>

</details>
